## Instructions

1. Cook the noodles and drain.
2. Fry the mushrooms in the butter till soft.
3. Stir the soup and milk together, add noodles, mushrooms and half the cheese.
4. Put in a greased casserole, top with the rest of the cheese and the crumbs.
5. Bake at 350 °F for 30 to 35 minutes.
